examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 夜市裡有很多有名的食物，又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de shíwù, yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: There is a lot of famous food in the night market; it's both cheap and delicious.

examples.chinese: 我去夜市，不但想吃牛肉麵，也想喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù yèshì, bùdàn xiǎng chī niúròumiàn, yě xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: When I go to the night market, I not only want to eat beef noodles but also want to drink bubble tea.

examples.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
examples.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

examples.chinese: 我們在逛夜市的時候，忽然下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài guàng yèshì de shíhòu, hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.english: While we were strolling through the night market, it suddenly started to rain.

examples.chinese: A:夜市在哪裡？ B:夜市就在前面！
examples.pinyin: A: Yèshì zài nǎlǐ? B: Yèshì jiù zài qiánmiàn!
examples.english: A: Where is the night market? B: The night market is just right ahead!

examples.chinese: 夜市裡有各種小吃和飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī hé yǐnliào.
examples.english: In the night market, there are various kinds of snacks and drinks.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 我是在台灣長大的，當然去過夜市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài Táiwān zhǎngdà de, dāngrán qùguo yèshì.
examples.english: I grew up in Taiwan, so of course I've been to night markets.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 他昨天去逛夜市的時候，信用卡被偷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù guàng yèshì de shíhou, xìnyòngkǎ bèi tōu le.
examples.english: When he went to the night market yesterday, his credit card was stolen.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，吸引了不少外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, xīyǐn le bùshǎo wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive and have attracted many foreign tourists.

examples.chinese: 弟弟昨天夜裡兩點才睡覺，難怪早上起不來。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái shuìjiào, nánguài zǎoshang qǐ bù lái.
examples.english: My younger brother didn't go to sleep until two o'clock last night; no wonder he couldn't get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 除夕那一天，要拜完祖先才能吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà yī tiān, yào bài wán zǔxiān cái néng chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you must finish worshipping the ancestors before you can eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 今年的年夜飯有很多菜，雞鴨魚肉什麼都有。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn yǒu hěn duō cài, jī yā yú ròu shénme dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This year's New Year's Eve dinner has many dishes: chicken, duck, fish, meat—everything.

examples.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese:
我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。
那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā.
Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english:
I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight.
That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 臺北當地的夜市有很多好吃的宵夜，改天我帶你去嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi dāngdì de yèshì yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de xiāoyè, gǎitiān wǒ dài nǐ qù chángchang.
examples.english: The local night markets in Taipei have many delicious late-night snacks; another day I'll take you to try them.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zuótiān bànyè fāshēng yánzhòng de huǒzāi, shòushāng de rénshù yuē yǒu sānshí míng.
examples.english: This hospital had a serious fire in the middle of the night yesterday; the number of people injured was about thirty.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 要去山上看夜景的話，最好帶著手電筒。
examples.pinyin: Yào qù shān shàng kàn yèjǐng de huà, zuìhǎo dài zhe shǒudiàntǒng.
examples.english: If you want to go up the mountain to see the nightscape, it's best to bring a flashlight.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Zài tiānqì hǎo de yèwǎn, xīngguāng kàn qǐlái gèngjiā làngmàn.
examples.english: On nights with good weather, the starlight looks even more romantic.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 在冬天的深夜裡，坐在溫暖的地毯上靜靜地看書是一種享受。
examples.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān de shēnyè lǐ, zuò zài wēnnuǎn de dìtǎn shàng jìngjìng de kànshū shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In the late night of winter, sitting on a warm carpet and reading quietly is a kind of enjoyment.

examples.chinese: 小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohán tèbié xǐ'ài shè qìqiú yóuxì, měi cì qù guàng yèshì shí zǒng yào wán wǔ, liù huí.
examples.english: Xiaohan especially loves shooting balloon games; every time he goes to the night market, he always plays five or six rounds.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

items.wordHook: a 亠(lid) rests over a 亻(person) who goes 夂(go) home → the late 夜(night).

examples.chinese: 這張照片裡的人都笑得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The people in this photo are all smiling very happily.

examples.chinese: 李先生喜歡開玩笑，是一個很有趣的人。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng xǐhuan kāi wánxiào, shì yīgè hěn yǒuqù de rén.
examples.english: Mr. Li likes to make jokes; he is a very interesting person.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥很喜歡說笑話，跟他在一起很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge hěn xǐhuan shuō xiàohua, gēn tā zài yìqǐ hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: My older brother really likes to tell jokes; being with him is very fun.

examples.chinese: 那個店員經常對客人微笑，讓人覺得很親切。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán jīngcháng duì kèrén wēixiào, ràng rén juéde hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: That clerk often smiles at customers, making people feel very friendly.

examples.chinese:
經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。
小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin:
Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo.
Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english:
The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well.
Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 他只是開個小玩笑而已，你何必那麼在乎呢？
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì kāi gè xiǎo wánxiào éryǐ, nǐ hébì nàme zàihu ne?
examples.english: He was just making a little joke, why should you care so much?

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

items.wordHook: a 竹(bamboo) takes a 夭(young) bend → breaking into a 笑(smile).

examples.chinese: 因為今天是爸爸的生日，所以晚餐非常豐富。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shì bàba de shēngrì, suǒyǐ wǎncān fēicháng fēngfù.
examples.english: Because today is Dad's birthday, the dinner is very abundant.

examples.chinese: 如果你希望有豐富的知識，就應該用功讀書。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xīwàng yǒu fēngfù de zhīshì, jiù yīnggāi yònggōng dúshū.
examples.english: If you hope to have abundant knowledge, you should study hard.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it.

examples.chinese: 這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jièshào le xǔduō Zhōngguó de gǔrén gǔshì, nèiróng jì fēngfù yòu yǒuqù.
examples.english: This novel introduces many stories of ancient Chinese people and events; its content is both rich and interesting.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù tígōng xīshì, zhōngshì liǎng zhǒng zǎocān, jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This bed and breakfast offers both Western-style and Chinese-style breakfasts, which are both rich and delicious.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 每年安排一段時間去旅行，說不定能帶給你更豐富的生活。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián ānpái yī duàn shíjiān qù lǚxíng, shuōbudìng néng dài gěi nǐ gèng fēngfù de shēnghuó.
examples.english: If you arrange a period of time to travel every year, it might bring you a richer life.

examples.chinese: 在指導演員的表達方式上，這位導演的經驗相當豐富。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhǐdǎo yǎnyuán de biǎodá fāngshì shàng, zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
examples.english: In guiding actors' ways of expression, this director's experience is quite rich.

examples.chinese: 去旅行的話，我有法子讓你用最少的預算擁有最豐富的行程。
examples.pinyin: Qù lǚxíng de huà, wǒ yǒu fǎzi ràng nǐ yòng zuì shǎo de yùsuàn yǒngyǒu zuì fēngfù de xíngchéng.
examples.english: If you go traveling, I have a way to let you have the richest itinerary with the smallest budget.

examples.chinese: 表情豐富、能模仿不同人物，是演員應有的基本條件。
examples.pinyin: Biǎoqíng fēngfù, néng mófǎng bùtóng rénwù, shì yǎnyuán yīng yǒu de jīběn tiáojiàn.
examples.english: Having rich facial expressions and being able to imitate different characters are basic requirements for an actor.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
examples.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
examples.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

examples.chinese: 本市的市立圖書館的書籍豐富，來借書的民眾也不少。
examples.pinyin: Běn shì de shìlì túshūguǎn de shūjí fēngfù, lái jiè shū de mínzhòng yě bùshǎo.
examples.english: The city's municipal library has a rich collection of books, and there are also many people who come to borrow books.

items.key: ["B2L12-2-17","服務生","服務生/服務員","服务生/服务员","N"]

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to the customers, which makes the customers all eat happily.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
examples.pinyin: Xíngdòng bù fāngbiàn de chéngkè chéngchē shí, chēzhàn yǒu fúwùyuán wèi tāmen fúwù.
examples.english: When passengers with limited mobility ride the train, there are service staff at the station to serve them.

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese:
那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。
聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin:
Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào.
Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english:
That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me.
I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

items.wordHook: Passing in just 一(one) fleeting stretch of 時(time): 一時 means a short while.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
examples.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

items.wordHook: Combining 播(play) and 出(go out): 播出 means broadcast, to televise.

examples.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
examples.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

examples.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
examples.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
examples.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
examples.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
examples.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

items.wordHook: Clearly 不(not) possessing 幸(favor): 不幸 means unfortunately.
A 亻(person) and a 賈(merchant) face each other; the number they settle on is the 價(price).
句(sentence) + 子(noun suffix) → a stretch of words: 句子(sentence).
國(country) + 家(home) → a nation is a country that feels like home.
A handy item for 日(sun) with suffix 子(child): 日子 means day.
